newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel dips with futures, but Gulf diffs firm.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel dips with futures, but Gulf diffs firm.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell sharply with futures Thursday, but stronger differentials helped Gulf material avert most of the NYMEX pain, traders said.

Gulf prompt front 31st cycle 54-grade fuel was offered at one cent below the December print, about 1.5 cents firmer than Wednesday diffs, while New York Harbor material firmed about 0.15 cent to 1.25 cents over November futures.
Traders attributed part of the strong Gulf move to a half-cent firming in differentials on heating oil in the region.
